_comment: Songfish-powered setlist archives. One entry per site; read by lib/setlistSources.js (which artist goes where) and netlify/functions/lib/songfishSites.js (which sites /api/band-setlist may call). A site with enabled: false is never resolved and never called. Turn one on only once permissionStatus is 'granted'. artistId is the site's numeric artist_id, checked against a live /api/v2/setlists/showyear/<y>.json response.

sites.permissionNote: In use since 5.33.0 on the public, keyless v2 API. No written permission on file yet.
Archive starts in 2010: Tedeschi Trucks Band only. Derek Trucks Band and Susan Tedeschi are not separate artists here.
The public band page already reads this site through config/public-artists.json; that pipeline does not use this entry.
